The app fills title and body. If this text is still here, paste from the clipboard (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V).

Attach the downloaded files when reporting a bug:

- `nexticon-feedback-*-screenshot.png`
- `nexticon-feedback-*-save.json` (optional)
- `nexticon-feedback-*-report.json`
- `nexticon-feedback-*-issue.md`
